description: Enforcement hooks: forbid-bash-patterns denies cd, git -C, sed/cat/awk, secret-leaking echo, loops, xargs, destructive find/sort and ad-hoc python in Bash; forbid-verbose-comments denies JSDoc and multi-line block comments added to TS/JS files (Claude only, per its header). Composed by compose-hooks.sh; every command is a ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/ path.
